title: Twist E21: Restrictions coupling the two Frobenius components
status_note: Proposed E21; not started. Coupled-family constructors, complete counters and independent projected-row replay are required. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:Coupled-family constructors, complete counters and independent projected-row replay are required.
question: Can a predicate involving both the rational and anti-rational components find useful relations more cheaply than direct collection on exactly the same projected base?
decision_value: Only a lower verified cost per independent projected row on heldout data justifies a solver/pipeline extension. Equal projected rows with no cost decrease close the tested predicate. No result bypasses Frobenius separation.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB; at most 2^20 counted group operations per relation cell and 60 seconds as a separate fail-safe. All construction and failed cells count. Exhaustive and sampled populations are reported separately. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.

env.recipe: Design only; implement native driver, independent checker, checkpoints and source/protocol pins before readiness.

funding.rationale: Blocked proposal with no run estimate, below the existing funded seed cards. Adding it changes no runnable-work priority or funding.
